standing_measurement.note: Includes interpreter startup and 30 seconds of the real sampler; excludes the existing process-event framework.

fork_denial.scope: Disposable macOS subprocess RLIMIT_NPROC=1; shared kern.maxprocperuid unchanged
fork_denial.library_watcher: Persisted census and returned status: pileup despite EAGAIN

limitations: Measurements reflect the current loaded host, not the author's earlier machine or interpreter.
Library and ps counts were observed at different times and fluctuate with unrelated host activity.
Linux counts real-UID threads; macOS enumerates user processes.
